subject: Error bar plot with only upper bar

messages.author: 16524dc094cde87d
messages.subject: Error bar plot with only upper bar
parts:
Hi All,

 I have a data set with three columns where the first column represents Chromosome #, column 2 contains a mean value (Mean) and column 3 contains the Standard Error (SE).

 I wanted to draw a error bar plot with only the upper bar i.e. using only ymax but I am unable to do that. I tried not using ymin but I get an error. My last try was ymin=Mean and if I can get the horizontal line away from the lower bar that also helps. Can anyone help? Here's my code:

d <-read.table("herit_by_chr.txt", header=T)
d$Chromosome <- as.factor(d$Chromosome)
gg<-ggplot(d,aes(d$Chromosome,Mean,SE))
x11(width=10, height=5)
print(gg+geom_bar(stat="identity")
+geom_errorbar(aes(ymax=Mean+SE,ymin=Mean,
col="red", width=1.0))+xlab("Chromosome")
+ylab("Phenotypic variability explained")
+ theme(legend.position = "none"))

 Thanks,

 -Shubhabrata
